comparison.objective: Pour a heavy pot of soup into a tureen without spilling, then return the pot to the hob.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual heavy-vessel load sharing, controlled tilting, liquid-like pouring, righting, and placement.
comparison.success_condition: At least 1,530 ml of 1,800 ml transferred, no more than 75 ml spilled, and pot upright on the hob; unsafe low-height tilt zeros the run. Damage to vessels is not specified.
comparison.reason: This is the closest generic pouring record, but it tests heavy vessel handling and bulk transfer. The candidate additionally tests selective aperture passage, orientation-dependent bridging, agitation, and retention of every washer, which are meaningfully different abilities.
